Three backbones per method

For every method, in the same order: ① its original pretrained backbone, ② our fine-tuned DINO dropped into that method’s pipeline, and ③ the method’s SAE version. Frames, resolution, layer and pooling stay fixed within a table. Each scene retrieves its ten nearest scenes from other driving logs, and we score how closely their next 4 s match the query’s.

In progress. Our method’s ③ and every method’s ④ (our fine-tuned DINO + Mehdi’s updated learned-gate SAE) need training and are running now; this page updates when they finish. Rows marked OLD SAE are the earlier hard-deletion SAE, kept only as a reference.

① original · ② our fine-tuned DINO · ③ SAE — 2,000 queries

Rows inside one table are directly comparable; rows in different tables are not. ADE is the mean error between the query’s 4 s future and each neighbour’s, in their own t0 ego frames. Δ ADE is paired: the same queries, scored with each backbone, differenced per query against ①, with a bootstrap 95% interval — green when the whole interval is below zero, red when above. Wins is the share of queries where that backbone’s neighbours drive closer to the query than ①’s. The best of ①–③ is highlighted; reference rows below the divider are there to interpret them, not to rank.

Our method

Our trunk is DINOv2 ViT-S/14. ① is stock, ② is our PAV fine-tune (30 of 175 tensors, blocks 10–11), ③ is the stock trunk with our SAE suppression (arm B′) running inside the forward pass.

DrivoR

DrivoR trains LoRA r32 on DINOv2-S/14-reg4; its base weights are bit-identical to timm’s release, so ① is exactly the pretrained backbone. ② runs our fine-tuned DINO through DrivoR’s own preprocessing. Our DINO has no register tokens, so the stock-DINOv2 reference row separates that architecture difference from the effect of our fine-tune.

How it was built

Our method. Trunk rows: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 on the cached 504×280 t0 frame. Readout rows: the scene aggregator of the trunk 2×2 models (DINOWaypointCLS, navtrain, 4,000 steps, seed 42), cell C with the stock trunk and cell D with the fine-tuned one — cell D’s trunk is bit-identical to the fine-tuned trunk in the rows above. Past motion joins only after the readout, so the readout is image-only.

DrivoR. Rebuilt from the shared checkpoints; the original backbone is the same LoRA model with the LoRA branch set to zero, verified against timm’s release (174/175 tensors identical, the last being timm’s own pos_embed resample, equal bit-for-bit). The +SAE model applies its gate inside the forward pass at blocks[10], as it runs. Readout = mean of the 16 scene tokens the planner reads.

Drive-JEPA. Original = vitl_merge_3dataset_e50.pt from the Drive-JEPA release; released and +SAE models from the shared checkpoints; the +SAE gate is applied on the projector as it runs.

Queries: 2,000 evenly spaced over the corpus; 30 display queries stratified by direction and speed. Neighbours always from other driving logs. Generated 2026-09-28T22:08:02Z.
